Since 1891

Two Swiss families settled this bend in the road. The trip from Jasper to Harrison took three days by wagon, and Little Switzerland was the first stop before the mountains.

  1. 1891

    Swiss settlers build the homestead. Travelers rest here and fill their water barrels before the climb north.

  2. 1930s

    The first rental cabins open for tourists. No electricity and no plumbing, just the outhouse and the view.

  3. 1960s

    Word spreads. Couples honeymoon here and kids spend their first mountain vacations here. Some still stop by to say hi.

  4. Today

    New owners are renovating cabin by cabin. Cabin 2 reopened in December 2025 with a king bed, granite and all new furniture.

Nearby

You're in the middle of the Buffalo River country. Here's where guests spend their days.

  • Buffalo National RiverAmerica's first national river. Float, swim and fish from accesses like Pruitt, Ozark and Kyle's Landing.
  • Arkansas Grand CanyonThe overlook on Highway 7 south of Jasper, with miles of Ozark ridges below. Best near sunset.
  • Lost Valley TrailAn easy hike near Ponca to Eden Falls and a cave you can walk into.
  • Elk in Boxley ValleyWild elk graze the fields near Ponca, most often at dawn and dusk.
  • Hawksbill CragA rock ledge over the upper Buffalo valley and one of the most photographed spots in Arkansas.
  • Downtown JasperOzark Cafe, Pizza on the Square, and the Cliff House Inn restaurant on the canyon rim.
  • Mystic CavernsGuided cave tours on Highway 7 north toward Harrison.
  • Branson and Eureka SpringsEach about an hour away for shows, shops and a day trip.

Good to know

Still wondering about something? Call or text Matt at (870) 416-2383.

Do the cabins have kitchens?

No full kitchens. Every unit has a mini fridge, microwave and coffee maker, and there's a covered pavilion with charcoal grills and picnic tables out back. Jasper's restaurants are about five minutes away. If you need a full kitchen, Morwood House has one.

Are dogs allowed?

Yes. Dogs are welcome for $25 per pet per stay. Let us know when you book.

What are check in and check out times?

Check in is after 4 PM and check out is by 11 AM. Check in is self serve, and we send instructions before you arrive.

Where exactly are you?

On Scenic Byway 7 (Highway 7), 2.5 miles north of Jasper, Arkansas, on the way to Harrison. The Buffalo National River crossing at Pruitt is a short drive north.

Can we book several cabins for a group?

Yes. The five units sleep 14 together, and Rooms 3 and 4 connect through an interior door. Add Morwood House, 3.5 miles south, and you can fit 22. Call or text Matt to hold everything at once.

Is there Wifi?

Yes, in every unit, along with a TV and air conditioning.

Why book here instead of Airbnb or VRBO?

Same cabins, same calendar, but you book straight with the owner and skip the app's service fee.
